newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were mostly steady and movement was slack, grain dealers in Kansas and Oklahoma said Wednesday.
"Basis is feeling pretty soggy down at the Gulf," one south central Kansas merchandiser said.
"If we had a pop up in the board, it might make some farmers interested in selling, but right now they're just hanging on," another Kansas merchandiser said.
Merchandisers noted that the season of railcar shortages was rapidly approaching, and they speculated whether this coming season would be as bad as last year.
"We'll be short railcars for four or five months no matter what happens, although we could see some relief this year" relative to previous years, a central Kansas dealer said.
Basis values are quoted against KCBT wheat, cash dollars/bu.
